4th Period.workingNow: Getting your JavaScript function working, then committing and pushing the final version.
4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: A basic JavaScript function embedded in your index.html, with the change committed and pushed to GitHub.
4th Period.smartGoal: I can commit and push a working JavaScript function in my HTML file so that my portfolio site does something interactive.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.14 — Create procedures with parameters to organize code and make it easier to reuse.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.10 — Writing literary and informational texts to present, describe, and explain ideas.
agenda: You do: finish/debug your JS function (15 min)
Partner check: does your partner's function run? (8 min)
Commit + push your final version (7 min)
Exit Ticket: paste your pushed commit link (5 min)
Bank payout: remaining minutes → free time (10 min)
4th Period.connections: This week you built the three foundations you'll need — commit/push, HTML navigation, and a working JS function. Next week we put all three to work forking and editing the Mario repo.

6th Period.workingNow: Finishing up your Game Lab project so it has at least two states triggered by an event.
6th Period.weeklyDeliverable: A Sprite Lab or Game Lab project where a scene or sprite has at least two states triggered by an event.
6th Period.smartGoal: I can test my game so that it shows at least two states, each triggered by an event.
6th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.12 — Design and iteratively develop programs that combine control structures, including compound conditionals.
6th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.10 — Writing literary and informational texts to present, describe, and explain ideas.
agenda: You do: finish + test your 2-state game (20 min)
Partner test: does your partner's game switch states? (8 min)
Exit Ticket: describe your two states and their triggers (5 min)
Bank payout: remaining minutes → free time (7 min)
6th Period.connections: This week you went from a paper state diagram to a real, working game with triggered states. Next week we keep building on this in Game Lab.
